generatorSets.controlTechnology: turbocharged engine and aftercooler/charge air cooler
turbocharged engine and aftercooler/charge air cooler

complianceRequirements: The engine-generator sets are subject to 40 CFR 63 Subpart ZZZZ (MACT) and 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII (NSPS) which require compliance with certain federal emission standards and operating limitations.
As the owner/operator, you are responsible for monitoring, testing, notification, reporting and recordkeeping requirements of the MACT and NSPS.
Notification shall only be sent to EPA, Region III.
Each engine-generator set (EG07-EG15 and EG-2-01 through EG-2-31) shall be equipped with a non-resettable hour metering device.
Operate and maintain according to manufacturer’s instructions or approved owner procedures.
Diesel fuel must meet ASTM D975 for S15 with maximum sulfur content 0.0015%.
Permittee must obtain a certification from the fuel supplier with each shipment detailing supplier, receipt date, quantity, ASTM D975 compliance, and sulfur content.
Visible emissions from each stack must not exceed opacity requirements except during one six-minute period per hour.
recordKeepingRequirements: Maintain records of emission data and operating parameters necessary to demonstrate compliance.

Maintain records for: annual hours of operation of each EG01-EG15 generator set, annual diesel fuel consumption of each EG-2-01 through EG-2-31, all fuel supplier certifications, engine details (make, model, serial number, model year, bhp, engine displacement), manufacturer’s operating instructions, reasons for operation (date, cause, hours), operation/monitoring records, stack test and visible emission results, maintenance and operator training.
Records must be retained for at least five years.
notifications: Written notification to DEQ Piedmont Regional Office: (a) actual date of construction for EG-2-01 through EG-2-31 within 30 days after such date; (b) anticipated start-up date 60-30 days prior for EG-2-01 through EG-2-31; (c) actual start-up date for EG-2-01 through EG-2-31 within 15 days after such date; (d) anticipated stack test/visible emissions evaluation at least 30 days prior for EG-2-01 through EG-2-31.
